description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryListener class, which handles lifecycle events (prePersist, preUpdate, postUpdate, postLoad) for EmployeeSalary entities, primarily to encrypt or decrypt the 'amount' field during database operations.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryListener
classes.description: A Doctrine event listener for EmployeeSalary entities that manages encryption and decryption of salary amounts during entity lifecycle events.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts the EmployeeSalary amount before persisting if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the EmployeeSalary amount before updating if encryption is enabled and the 'amount' field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the EmployeeSalary amount after the entity has been updated, if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the EmployeeSalary amount after it has been loaded from the database, if encryption is enabled.
